START HERE  |  All Teams is the complete filterable list. Country tabs contain domestic teams only; UEFA has the three league phases.
Counts are competition memberships, not unique clubs: a club may appear domestically and in UEFA. Reserve sides remain separate teams.
Open Competitions to check expected versus listed team counts for every league.
Open Sources for the source register. Every team row also contains its source URL.
2026/27 for all competitions except Finland's domestic leagues, which use the 2026 calendar-year season.
Only the 36 league-phase entrants per competition are listed. Clubs eliminated in qualifying are excluded. UEFA rows cover all associations, not only the eight domestic countries.
Every regional group is included. Group labels are opening-phase allocations; later play-off or continuation splits are not counted as separate leagues. Reserve teams are explicitly labelled.

Country means domestic league system or UEFA association, not necessarily geographic location. Cardiff City, Swansea City and Wrexham are under England; FC Andorra is under Spain; Monaco is under France.
France's third tier is Ligue 3 (formerly National). Greece's Super League 2 is a unified division. Finland's second and third tiers are Ykkösliiga and Ykkönen.

Greek Gamma Ethniki rows are published entrants before the season starts. This is a static snapshot checked on 11 September 2026, not a live feed. Source register labels official and secondary references.
Colour names are now appended to All Teams, every country tab and UEFA. The dedicated Club Colours tab provides a compact directory, sources and illustrative HEX values.
Not all palettes are current or official. Historical references and parent-team inferences are labelled; missing values are left unguessed. Generic swatches are not official club-brand colours.
